description: LocalCode coding agent inside your IDE: local models, tasks, tool approvals and code review.
serverUrl: LocalCode Desktop loopback URL. Only HTTP on 127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1] is accepted. Shared with the desktop application.
executablePath: Absolute path to an installed LocalCode executable. Empty uses the standard Windows per-user installation. Launched only by Start LocalCode.
language: Interface language. Automatic follows the Windows display language reported by LocalCode; falls back to the IDE language while disconnected.
agentosUrl: Loopback HTTP URL of AgentOS for Cross-Vendor Adversarial Review (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8010). Non-loopback URLs are blocked.
fimEnabled: Enable local Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) inline autocomplete using a loopback model endpoint.
fimModel: Local model used for low-latency FIM inline autocomplete (for example qwen2.5-coder:1.5b).
fimEndpoint: Loopback HTTP endpoint for FIM autocomplete (Ollama or llama.cpp, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434). Non-loopback URLs are blocked.
fimDebounceMs: Debounce delay in milliseconds before requesting a FIM completion after typing.
fimLatencyBudgetMs: Maximum latency budget in milliseconds for a single FIM completion request.
fimTemplate: Prompt token template for FIM autocomplete (auto, qwen, starcoder, or codellama).
inlineEditEndpoint: Optional loopback HTTP endpoint for Inline Edit (defaults to fimEndpoint when empty).
inlineEditModel: Optional local model for Inline Edit (defaults to fimModel when empty).
